defaults.source: Distilled from [playwright.dev](https://playwright.dev) — the guides, the test-runner reference and the full library API — retrieved 2026-08-20.

writing.title: Playwright: writing tests
writing.description: Playwright test authoring: locators, actions, assertions, auto-waiting, authentication, accessibility, emulation, evaluating in the page. Use when writing or fixing a Playwright test.
writing.intro: The day-to-day surface. Locators and web-first assertions carry the auto-waiting that makes a test stable — reach for them before any explicit wait.

runner.title: Playwright: test runner
runner.description: Playwright test runner: playwright.config, projects, fixtures, parallelism and sharding, retries, reporters, component testing, page object model, CI. Use when configuring a Playwright suite.
runner.intro: How a suite is structured and executed, rather than what a single test does.

library.title: Playwright: library API
library.description: Playwright library API: Page, Browser, BrowserContext, Locator, Request, Response, network routing, devices, file and clipboard IO, API testing. Use when automating a browser outside the test runner.
library.intro: The complete class reference, for automation and for the parts of a test the guides do not cover.

debugging.title: Playwright: debugging
debugging.description: Playwright debugging: trace viewer, inspector, PWDEBUG, UI mode, flaky tests, migration from other frameworks. Use when a Playwright test fails unclearly or is flaky.
debugging.intro: A failing trace answers more questions than a rerun. Start with the trace viewer.

tooling.title: Playwright: MCP and CLI tooling
tooling.description: Playwright tooling: the Playwright MCP server and its tools, the agent CLI and its commands, browser installation. Use when the request names Playwright MCP or the Playwright CLI.
tooling.intro: The tooling around the library: MCP for agent-driven browsing, the CLI for installation and codegen.
